goal: 100 source-disjoint candidates for reviewable Upstream work; no automatic fork or publication grant
selection_rule: Preserve 16 verified working forks and 23 historical technical packets without forks (current MIT/Apache-2.0 metadata). Add 61 previously unbatched included Index sources in two complementary lanes: 25 high-reach popular candidates, including the ten originally discussed with the owner, sorted by live GitHub stars; 36 stronger source-specific native mechanism candidates allocated across S2, S3, S3*, S4 and S5 based on recent Index evidence, specificity and code references. Both lanes require current MIT/Apache-2.0 metadata and source activity since 2026-09-01. Stars approximate audience and potential impact, not quality, code defect, or proof of improvement. All hypotheses need pre-registration and independent native verification before external action.
